newsitem.title: USA: US copper center shipments Jan-May up year to date.
newsitem.headline: US copper center shipments Jan-May up year to date.

text.p: The average daily shipping rate from U.S. copper service centers in May was unchanged from April, but total metal shipped dropped in the shorter month of May, the Copper & Brass Servicenter Association reported.
Shipments of copper products dropped 8.2 percent month to month, whle alloy products fell 3.7 percent.
Service center shipments of copper pipe and tube were off 25.8 percent during May from April, while alloy pipe and tube shipments climbed 17.7 percent month to month.

"It is encouraging to note that after the initial five months of the year, in all categories except copper and alloy plate, service centers are running significantly ahead of the companion period of 1996," CBSA reported.
Total copper sales in January through May are up 12.6 percent while total alloys sales are up 5.4 percent.
